programs.title: Big Cat Planet
programs.desc: Big cats, symbols of wild nature, today face the challenge of survival in a changing world.More and more often, their paths cross with people, leading to inevitable conflicts.On this journey, we learn about their unique adaptive skills: cheetahs use cars for hunting, jaguars dive near boats, and lions appear more and more often on the streets of Indian cities.This fresh look shows the cunning of predators that are still among the most dangerous inhabitants of nature.

programs.title: Predator Fail: When Prey Attacks
programs.desc: When a predator attacks, potential prey usually has no chance.Sometimes, however, the would-be victim can surprise the attacker very much.

programs.title: America The Beautiful: Wild Frontier
programs.desc: A documentary series devoted to the American border and its nature.The program presents the legends of the Wild West, which are intertwined with stories about local animal species.

programs.title: Europe's Great Wilderness
programs.desc: Europe remains the world's second smallest continent and is incredibly diverse.Temperatures there reach from +40 to -40 degrees.The three-part documentary will show its unique nature.
